title: 'Fastware' - Andrei Alexandrescu [ ACCU 2016 ]
summary: Andrei Alexandrescu's ACCU 2016 talk previews material from his book on writing fast code, with a focus on optimization techniques such as sentinels and faster search.
why: HN recommends it as a careful, entertaining talk on low-level optimization that shows how textbook algorithms can be sped up.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: If you’re skeptical, I really do encourage you to watch, he’s not sloppy.
